class Process(string id, int arrival, int priority, int[] bursts)
    deadline := 0
class Burst(int length, int ready)
    start := -1
    end := 0
    slices := 0
class Job(Process definition)
    state := "FUTURE"
    burst := 0
    int left := definition.bursts[0]
    int effective := definition.priority
    wait := 0
    level := 0
    used := 0
    enqueued := 0
    start := -1
    finish := 0
    slices := 0
    Burst[] records := []
    timeline := ""
class Simulation(int algorithm, int[] parameters)
    Job[] jobs := []
    int[][] queues := [[], [], []]
    cpu := "IDLE"
    current := -1
    previous := -1
    switch_left := 0
    run := 0
    switches := 0
    end := 0
    busy := 0
    switching := 0
    idle := 0
    maxq := 0
    sumq := 0
    events := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    int random_state := parameters[4]
    int[] labels := []
    string[] log := []
    string[] snapshot := []
    totals := [0, 0, 0]
    missed := 0
    met := 0
class Scheduler()
    Process[] registry := []
string[] algorithms()
    return "FCFS SJF SRTF RR PRIORITY HRRN EDF LOTTERY MLFQ".split(" ")
string[] keys()
    return "cs q k s seed".split(" ")
string[] metrics()
    return "turnaround waiting response end switches missed".split(" ")
int lookup(const string[] values, string text)
    for: index < #values
        if values[index] == text
            return int(index)
    return -1
int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b
int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b
int process_at(const Scheduler scheduler, string id)
    for: index < #scheduler.registry
        if scheduler.registry[index].id == id
            return int(index)
    return -1
bool uses(int algorithm, int key)
    return algorithm < 0 or key == 0 or (key == 1 and (algorithm == 3 or algorithm == 7)) or (key == 2 and algorithm == 4) or (key == 3 and algorithm == 8) or (key == 4 and algorithm == 7)
string notation(const int[] parameters, algorithm := -1)
    string[] result := []
    names := keys()
    for: index < 5
        if uses(algorithm, index)
            result = result.append("{names[index]}={parameters[index]}")
    return result.join(" ")
string decimal(int numerator, int denominator)
    value := numerator * 100 / denominator
    fraction := value % 100
    return "{value / 100}." + (if fraction < 10 then "0" else "") + string(fraction)
int[] | error parse_parameters(const string[] words, int algorithm, int preset)
    parameters := [0, 4, 5, 0, 1]
    lower := [0, 1, 1, 0, 1]
    upper := [5, 20, 50, 500, 2147483646]
    seen := array(5, fill = false)
    if preset >= 0
        seen[preset] = true
    for word := words[]
        parts := word.split("=")
        key := lookup(keys(), parts[0])
        if key < 0
            return error("unknown key {parts[0]}")
        if not uses(algorithm, key)
            names := algorithms()
            return error("key {parts[0]} not allowed for {names[algorithm]}")
        if seen[key]
            return error("duplicate key {parts[0]}")
        value := int(parts[1])
        if value < lower[key] or value > upper[key]
            return error("invalid {parts[0]}")
        seen[key] = true
        parameters[key] = value
    return parameters
int draw(int &random_state, int modulus)
    random_state = 48271 * random_state % 2147483647
    return random_state % modulus
string describe(const Process definition)
    string[] bursts := []
    for: index < #definition.bursts
        bursts = bursts.append((if index % 2 == 0 then "C" else "I") + string(definition.bursts[index]))
    return "{definition.id} arrival={definition.arrival} priority={definition.priority} deadline=" + (if definition.deadline == 0 then "none" else string(definition.deadline)) + " bursts=" + bursts.join(",")
Process[] sorted_processes(const Scheduler scheduler)
    names := [for definition := scheduler.registry[] then definition.id]
    Process[] result := []
    for name := names.sorted()[]
        result = result.append(scheduler.registry[process_at(scheduler, name)])
    return result
void record(Simulation &simulation, int clock, int kind, index := -1, value := -1)
    names := "PREEMPT EXPIRE DEMOTE BOOST AGE ARRIVE IODONE START DONE IO SWITCH DISPATCH".split(" ")
    if kind < 5
        simulation.events[kind] += 1
    line := "{clock} {names[kind]}"
    if index >= 0
        line += " {simulation.jobs[index].definition.id}"
    if value >= 0
        line += " {value}"
    simulation.log = simulation.log.append(line)
void enqueue(Simulation &simulation, int index, int clock)
    simulation.jobs[index].state = "READY"
    simulation.jobs[index].enqueued = clock
    level := if simulation.algorithm == 8 then simulation.jobs[index].level else 0
    simulation.queues[level] = simulation.queues[level].append(index)
void start(Simulation &simulation, int index, int clock)
    simulation.cpu = "RUN"
    simulation.current = index
    simulation.run = 0
    simulation.jobs[index].state = "RUN"
    if simulation.jobs[index].start < 0
        simulation.jobs[index].start = clock
    burst := simulation.jobs[index].burst / 2
    if simulation.jobs[index].records[burst].start < 0
        simulation.jobs[index].records[burst].start = clock
int deadline(const Job job)
    return if job.definition.deadline == 0 then 1000000000 else job.definition.arrival + job.definition.deadline
bool preempts(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    job := simulation.jobs[index]
    for: level < 3
        for other := simulation.queues[level][]
            candidate := simulation.jobs[other]
            if (simulation.algorithm == 2 and candidate.left < job.left) or (simulation.algorithm == 4 and candidate.effective < job.effective) or (simulation.algorithm == 6 and deadline(candidate) < deadline(job)) or (simulation.algorithm == 8 and level < job.level)
                return true
    return false
int choose(Simulation &simulation, int level, int clock)
    queue := simulation.queues[level]
    if simulation.algorithm == 7
        total := 0
        for index := queue[]
            total += 10 - simulation.jobs[index].definition.priority
        ticket := draw(&simulation.random_state, total)
        for: position < #queue
            ticket -= 10 - simulation.jobs[queue[position]].definition.priority
            if ticket < 0
                return int(position)
    selected := 0
    for: 1 <= position < int(#queue)
        candidate := simulation.jobs[queue[position]]
        previous := simulation.jobs[queue[selected]]
        better := false
        if simulation.algorithm == 1 or simulation.algorithm == 2
            better = candidate.left < previous.left
        elif simulation.algorithm == 4
            better = candidate.effective < previous.effective
        elif simulation.algorithm == 5
            better = (clock - candidate.enqueued + candidate.left) * previous.left > (clock - previous.enqueued + previous.left) * candidate.left
        elif simulation.algorithm == 6
            better = deadline(candidate) < deadline(previous)
        if better
            selected = position
    return selected
void capture(Simulation &simulation)
    result := [if simulation.cpu == "IDLE" then "CPU IDLE" else "CPU {simulation.cpu} {simulation.jobs[simulation.current].definition.id}"]
    for: level < (if simulation.algorithm == 8 then 3 else 1)
        names := [for index := simulation.queues[level][] then simulation.jobs[index].definition.id]
        result = result.append((if simulation.algorithm == 8 then "QUEUE{level} " else "QUEUE ") + (if #names == 0 then "none" else names.join(" ")))
    for job := simulation.jobs[]
        line := "{job.definition.id} {job.state}"
        if job.state == "FUTURE"
            line += " at={job.definition.arrival}"
        elif job.state == "DONE"
            line += " at={job.finish}"
        else
            line += " burst={job.burst + 1} left={job.left}"
            if simulation.algorithm == 4
                line += " prio={job.effective}"
            elif simulation.algorithm == 8
                line += " level={job.level} used={job.used}"
        result = result.append(line)
    simulation.snapshot = result
int metric(const Job job, int index)
    turnaround := job.finish - job.definition.arrival
    if index == 0
        return turnaround
    if index == 2
        return job.start - job.definition.arrival
    total := 0
    for length := job.definition.bursts[]
        total += length
    return turnaround - total
Simulation simulate(const Scheduler scheduler, int algorithm, const int[] parameters, snapshot_time := -1)
    simulation := Simulation(algorithm, parameters)
    for definition := sorted_processes(scheduler)[]
        simulation.jobs = simulation.jobs.append(Job(definition))
    clock := 0
    while true
        if algorithm == 4
            for index := simulation.queues[0][]
                simulation.jobs[index].wait += 1
                if simulation.jobs[index].wait == parameters[2]
                    simulation.jobs[index].wait = 0
                    if simulation.jobs[index].effective > 0
                        simulation.jobs[index].effective -= 1
                        record(&simulation, clock, 4, index, simulation.jobs[index].effective)
        for: position < #simulation.jobs
            index := int(position)
            job := simulation.jobs[index]
            if job.state == "IO" and job.left == 0
                simulation.jobs[index].burst += 1
                length := job.definition.bursts[job.burst + 1]
                simulation.jobs[index].left = length
                simulation.jobs[index].records = job.records.append(Burst(length, clock))
                enqueue(&simulation, index, clock)
                record(&simulation, clock, 6, index)
        for: position < #simulation.jobs
            index := int(position)
            job := simulation.jobs[index]
            if job.state == "FUTURE" and job.definition.arrival == clock
                simulation.jobs[index].records = [Burst(job.left, clock)]
                enqueue(&simulation, index, clock)
                record(&simulation, clock, 5, index)
        if simulation.cpu == "SWITCH" and simulation.switch_left == 0
            start(&simulation, simulation.current, clock)
            record(&simulation, clock, 7, simulation.current)
        elif simulation.cpu == "RUN"
            index := simulation.current
            job := simulation.jobs[index]
            if job.left == 0 and job.burst + 1 == int(#job.definition.bursts)
                simulation.jobs[index].state = "DONE"
                simulation.jobs[index].finish = clock
                record(&simulation, clock, 8, index)
                simulation.cpu = "IDLE"
            else
                demoted := algorithm == 8 and job.level < 2 and job.used == (if job.level == 0 then 4 else 8)
                if demoted
                    simulation.jobs[index].level += 1
                    simulation.jobs[index].used = 0
                    record(&simulation, clock, 2, index, job.level + 1)
                if job.left == 0
                    simulation.jobs[index].burst += 1
                    length := job.definition.bursts[job.burst + 1]
                    simulation.jobs[index].left = length
                    simulation.jobs[index].state = "IO"
                    record(&simulation, clock, 9, index, length)
                    simulation.cpu = "IDLE"
                elif demoted
                    enqueue(&simulation, index, clock)
                    simulation.cpu = "IDLE"
                elif (algorithm == 3 or algorithm == 7) and simulation.run == parameters[1]
                    enqueue(&simulation, index, clock)
                    record(&simulation, clock, 1, index)
                    simulation.cpu = "IDLE"
                elif preempts(simulation, index)
                    enqueue(&simulation, index, clock)
                    record(&simulation, clock, 0, index)
                    simulation.cpu = "IDLE"
        finished := true
        for job := simulation.jobs[]
            if job.state != "DONE"
                finished = false
        if finished
            simulation.end = clock
            if snapshot_time >= 0 and #simulation.snapshot == 0
                capture(&simulation)
            break
        if algorithm == 8 and parameters[3] > 0 and clock > 0 and clock % parameters[3] == 0
            simulation.queues[0] = simulation.queues[0].concat(simulation.queues[1]).concat(simulation.queues[2])
            simulation.queues[1] = []
            simulation.queues[2] = []
            for: index < #simulation.jobs
                simulation.jobs[index].level = 0
                simulation.jobs[index].used = 0
            record(&simulation, clock, 3)
        if simulation.cpu == "IDLE"
            level := -1
            for: candidate < 3
                if level < 0 and #simulation.queues[candidate] > 0
                    level = candidate
            if level >= 0
                position := choose(&simulation, level, clock)
                index := simulation.queues[level][position]
                queue := simulation.queues[level]
                simulation.queues[level] = queue[:<position].concat(queue[position + 1:])
                simulation.jobs[index].effective = simulation.jobs[index].definition.priority
                simulation.jobs[index].wait = 0
                simulation.jobs[index].slices += 1
                simulation.jobs[index].records[simulation.jobs[index].burst / 2].slices += 1
                changed := index != simulation.previous
                if changed
                    simulation.switches += 1
                if changed and parameters[0] > 0
                    simulation.cpu = "SWITCH"
                    simulation.current = index
                    simulation.switch_left = parameters[0]
                    simulation.jobs[index].state = "SWITCH"
                    record(&simulation, clock, 10, index)
                else
                    start(&simulation, index, clock)
                    record(&simulation, clock, 11, index)
        if clock == snapshot_time
            capture(&simulation)
        queue_length := int(#simulation.queues[0] + #simulation.queues[1] + #simulation.queues[2])
        simulation.sumq += queue_length
        simulation.maxq = maximum(simulation.maxq, queue_length)
        for: index < #simulation.jobs
            state := simulation.jobs[index].state
            simulation.jobs[index].timeline += if state == "READY" then "." elif state == "SWITCH" then "s" elif state == "RUN" then "#" elif state == "IO" then "i" else "-"
        if simulation.cpu == "RUN"
            index := simulation.current
            simulation.jobs[index].left -= 1
            simulation.jobs[index].used += 1
            simulation.run += 1
            simulation.previous = index
            simulation.labels = simulation.labels.append(index)
            simulation.busy += 1
            if simulation.jobs[index].left == 0
                simulation.jobs[index].records[simulation.jobs[index].burst / 2].end = clock + 1
        elif simulation.cpu == "SWITCH"
            simulation.switch_left -= 1
            simulation.labels = simulation.labels.append(-2)
            simulation.switching += 1
        else
            simulation.labels = simulation.labels.append(-1)
            simulation.idle += 1
        for: index < #simulation.jobs
            if simulation.jobs[index].state == "IO"
                simulation.jobs[index].left -= 1
        clock += 1
    for job := simulation.jobs[]
        for: index < 3
            simulation.totals[index] += metric(job, index)
        if job.definition.deadline > 0
            if job.finish > deadline(job)
                simulation.missed += 1
            else
                simulation.met += 1
    return simulation
string[] averages(const Simulation simulation)
    return [for total := simulation.totals[] then decimal(total, int(#simulation.jobs))]
string utilization(const Simulation simulation)
    return decimal(simulation.busy * 100, simulation.end)
string label(const Simulation simulation, int clock)
    index := simulation.labels[clock]
    return if index == -1 then "IDLE" elif index == -2 then "CS" else simulation.jobs[index].definition.id
string pad(string text, bool left)
    result := text
    while #result < 8
        result = if left then " " + result else result + " "
    return result
string table_row(const string[] columns)
    result := pad(columns[0], false)
    for: 1 <= index < int(#columns)
        result += " " + pad(columns[index], true)
    return result
string[] output_simulation(string command, const Simulation simulation, int argument)
    names := algorithms()
    header := "{command} {names[simulation.algorithm]} " + notation(simulation.parameters, simulation.algorithm)
    if command == "TRACE"
        return [header].concat(simulation.log).append("END {simulation.end}")
    if command == "SNAPSHOT"
        return [header + " t={argument}"].concat(simulation.snapshot)
    if command == "TIMELINE"
        result := [header + " end={simulation.end}"]
        for job := simulation.jobs[]
            result = result.append(pad(job.definition.id, false) + " " + job.timeline)
        return result
    result := [header + (if command == "WINDOW" then " width={argument}" else "")]
    if command == "BURSTS"
        for job := simulation.jobs[]
            for: index < #job.records
                burst := job.records[index]
                result = result.append("{job.definition.id} #{index + 1} len={burst.length} ready={burst.ready} start={burst.start} end={burst.end} wait={burst.end - burst.ready - burst.length} slices={burst.slices}")
        return result
    if command == "STATS"
        metric_names := metrics()
        for: index < 3
            values := [for job := simulation.jobs[] then metric(job, index)]
            low_index := 0
            high_index := 0
            for: position < #values
                if values[position] < values[low_index]
                    low_index = int(position)
                if values[position] > values[high_index]
                    high_index = int(position)
            ordered := values.sorted()
            middle := int(#values) / 2
            doubled := if #values % 2 == 1 then 2 * ordered[middle] else ordered[middle - 1] + ordered[middle]
            result = result.append("{metric_names[index]} min={values[low_index]} ({simulation.jobs[low_index].definition.id}) max={values[high_index]} ({simulation.jobs[high_index].definition.id}) median={doubled / 2}.{5 * (doubled % 2)} total={simulation.totals[index]}")
        return result
    if command == "WINDOW"
        start_time := 0
        while start_time < simulation.end
            end_time := minimum(start_time + argument, simulation.end)
            busy := 0
            switching := 0
            idle := 0
            counts := array(#simulation.jobs, fill = 0)
            for: start_time <= clock < end_time
                index := simulation.labels[clock]
                if index == -1
                    idle += 1
                elif index == -2
                    switching += 1
                else
                    busy += 1
                    counts[index] += 1
            top := -1
            for: index < #counts
                if counts[index] > 0 and (top < 0 or counts[index] > counts[top])
                    top = int(index)
            result = result.append("{start_time}-{end_time} busy={busy} switch={switching} idle={idle} util={decimal(busy * 100, end_time - start_time)} top=" + (if top < 0 then "none" else simulation.jobs[top].definition.id))
            start_time = end_time
        return result
    start_time := 0
    gantt := "GANTT "
    segments := 0
    for: 1 <= clock <= simulation.end
        if clock == simulation.end or label(simulation, clock) != label(simulation, start_time)
            gantt += "[{start_time}-{clock} {label(simulation, start_time)}]"
            segments += 1
            if segments % 8 == 0 or clock == simulation.end
                result = result.append(gantt)
                gantt = "GANTT "
            start_time = clock
    for job := simulation.jobs[]
        line := "{job.definition.id} arrival={job.definition.arrival} done={job.finish} turnaround={metric(job, 0)} waiting={metric(job, 1)} response={metric(job, 2)} slices={job.slices}"
        if job.definition.deadline > 0
            line += " deadline={deadline(job)} late={maximum(0, job.finish - deadline(job))}"
        result = result.append(line)
    av := averages(simulation)
    result = result.append("AVERAGE turnaround={av[0]} waiting={av[1]} response={av[2]}")
    result = result.append("CPU end={simulation.end} busy={simulation.busy} switch={simulation.switching} idle={simulation.idle} switches={simulation.switches} util={utilization(simulation)}")
    result = result.append("QUEUE max={simulation.maxq} avg={decimal(simulation.sumq, simulation.end)}")
    result = result.append("EVENTS preempt={simulation.events[0]} expire={simulation.events[1]} demote={simulation.events[2]} boost={simulation.events[3]} age={simulation.events[4]}")
    return result.append("DEADLINE met={simulation.met} missed={simulation.missed}")
int rank_value(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    return if index < 3 then simulation.totals[index] elif index == 3 then simulation.end elif index == 4 then simulation.switches else simulation.missed
string[] | error execute(Scheduler &scheduler, const string[] words)
    command := words[0]
    if command == "PROC"
        id := words[1]
        if process_at(scheduler, id) >= 0
            return error("duplicate process {id}")
        if #scheduler.registry == 10
            return error("too many processes")
        arrival := int(words[2])
        priority := int(words[3])
        if arrival > 200
            return error("invalid arrival {id}")
        if priority > 9
            return error("invalid priority {id}")
        if (#words - 4) % 2 == 0
            return error("invalid bursts {id}")
        int[] bursts := []
        cpu := 0
        io := 0
        for: 4 <= index < int(#words)
            word := words[index]
            length := int(word[1:])
            if word[0] != (if index % 2 == 0 then "C" else "I") or length < 1 or length > 30
                return error("invalid bursts {id}")
            bursts = bursts.append(length)
            if index % 2 == 0
                cpu += length
            else
                io += length
        scheduler.registry = scheduler.registry.append(Process(id, arrival, priority, bursts))
        return ["PROC {id} cpu={cpu} io={io}"]
    if command == "GEN"
        count := int(words[2])
        for: 1 <= number <= count
            id := words[1] + string(number)
            if process_at(scheduler, id) >= 0
                return error("duplicate process {id}")
        if int(#scheduler.registry) + count > 10
            return error("too many processes")
        result := ["GEN count={count}"]
        random_state := int(words[3])
        for: 1 <= number <= count
            arrival := draw(&random_state, 21)
            priority := draw(&random_state, 10)
            count_bursts := 1 + draw(&random_state, 3)
            int[] bursts := []
            for: index < count_bursts
                if index > 0
                    bursts = bursts.append(1 + draw(&random_state, 8))
                bursts = bursts.append(1 + draw(&random_state, 9))
            definition := Process(words[1] + string(number), arrival, priority, bursts)
            scheduler.registry = scheduler.registry.append(definition)
            result = result.append(describe(definition))
        return result
    if command == "SETPRIO" or command == "DEADLINE" or command == "DROP"
        index := process_at(scheduler, words[1])
        if index < 0
            return error("unknown process {words[1]}")
        if command == "DROP"
            scheduler.registry = scheduler.registry[:<index].concat(scheduler.registry[index + 1:])
            return ["DROP {words[1]}"]
        value := int(words[2])
        priority := command == "SETPRIO"
        if value > (if priority then 9 else 1000)
            return error("invalid " + (if priority then "priority" else "deadline") + " {words[1]}")
        if priority
            scheduler.registry[index].priority = value
            return ["SETPRIO {words[1]} priority={value}"]
        scheduler.registry[index].deadline = value
        return ["DEADLINE {words[1]} " + (if value == 0 then "none" else string(value))]
    if command == "CLEAR"
        count := int(#scheduler.registry)
        scheduler.registry = []
        return ["CLEAR count={count}"]
    if command == "LIST"
        return ["LIST count={#scheduler.registry}"].concat([for definition := sorted_processes(scheduler)[] then describe(definition)])
    all := command == "COMPARE" or command == "RANK"
    diff := command == "DIFF"
    algorithm := -1
    second := -1
    metric_index := -1
    offset := 2
    names := algorithms()
    if not all
        algorithm = lookup(names, words[1])
        if algorithm < 0
            return error("unknown algorithm {words[1]}")
        if diff
            second = lookup(names, words[2])
            offset = 3
            if second < 0
                return error("unknown algorithm {words[2]}")
    elif command == "RANK"
        metric_index = lookup(metrics(), words[1])
        if metric_index < 0
            return error("unknown metric {words[1]}")
    else
        offset = 1
    argument := -1
    key := -1
    lower := 0
    upper := 0
    if command == "SNAPSHOT" or command == "WINDOW"
        argument = int(words[2])
        offset = 3
        if command == "WINDOW" and (argument < 1 or argument > 1000)
            return error("invalid window")
    if command == "SWEEP"
        key = lookup(keys(), words[2])
        if key < 0
            return error("unknown key {words[2]}")
        if not uses(algorithm, key)
            return error("key {words[2]} not allowed for {names[algorithm]}")
        lower = int(words[3])
        upper = int(words[4])
        lows := [0, 1, 1, 0, 1]
        highs := [5, 20, 50, 500, 2147483646]
        if lower > upper or lower < lows[key] or upper > highs[key] or upper - lower > 20
            return error("invalid range")
        offset = 5
    parameters := try parse_parameters(words[offset:], if all or diff then -1 else algorithm, key)
    if #scheduler.registry == 0
        return error("no processes")
    note := notation(parameters, if all or diff then -1 else algorithm)
    if key >= 0
        result := ["SWEEP {names[algorithm]} {words[2]} {lower} {upper}"]
        best_total := -1
        best_value := lower
        for: lower <= value <= upper
            parameters[key] = value
            simulation := simulate(scheduler, algorithm, parameters)
            av := averages(simulation)
            result = result.append(notation(parameters, algorithm) + " turnaround={av[0]} waiting={av[1]} response={av[2]} util={utilization(simulation)} end={simulation.end} switches={simulation.switches}")
            if best_total < 0 or simulation.totals[1] < best_total
                best_total = simulation.totals[1]
                best_value = value
        return result.append("BEST {words[2]}={best_value}")
    if diff
        one := simulate(scheduler, algorithm, parameters)
        two := simulate(scheduler, second, parameters)
        result := ["DIFF {words[1]} {words[2]} {note}"]
        wins := 0
        losses := 0
        ties := 0
        for: index < #one.jobs
            a := one.jobs[index]
            b := two.jobs[index]
